headline: Used Cars Could Become Cheaper
summary: A change to the VAT calculation rules for second-hand car sales is being proposed in Azerbaijan. The matter concerns proposed amendments to the Tax Code, and the report says used cars could become cheaper.
why: Tax rules on used-vehicle sales affect dealer pricing and consumer demand in the car market. Changes to the Tax Code are typically watched by retailers and automakers.
